description: Fur-box PWM scan of the PP_0908 promoter against a genomic null distribution, with known iron-starvation genes as positive controls
code:
import requests, re, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils"; NUC="NC_002947.4"

def coords(locus):
    r=requests.get(f"{E}/esearch.fcgi",params={"db":"gene","term":f"{locus}[Gene Name] AND 160488[Taxonomy ID]",
                                               "retmode":"json"},timeout=60).json()
    ids=r["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
    if not ids: return None
    time.sleep(0.4)
    s=requests.get(f"{E}/esummary.fcgi",params={"db":"gene","id":ids[0],"retmode":"json"},timeout=60).json()
    g=s["result"][ids[0]]["genomicinfo"][0]
    return int(g["chrstart"])+1, int(g["chrstop"])+1
def seq(lo,hi,strand=1):
    p={"db":"nuccore","id":NUC,"seq_start":lo,"seq_stop":hi,"rettype":"fasta","retmode":"text"}
    if strand==2: p["strand"]=2
    t=requests.get(f"{E}/efetch.fcgi",params=p,timeout=90).text
    return "".join(l.strip() for l in t.splitlines() if not l.startswith(">")).upper()
def upstream(c,n=400):
    s,e=c
    return seq(max(1,s-n),s-1,1) if s<e else seq(s+1,s+n,2)

CONS="GATAATGATAATCATTATC"; B={"A":0,"C":1,"G":2,"T":3}
pwm=np.full((4,len(CONS)),0.08)
for i,c in enumerate(CONS): pwm[B[c],i]=0.76
lpwm=np.log2(pwm/0.25)
def best_score(s):
    L=len(CONS); best=-1e9; pos=None
    for st,ss in (("+",s),("-",s[::-1].translate(str.maketrans("ACGT","TGCA")))):
        for i in range(len(ss)-L+1):
            w=ss[i:i+L]
            if any(c not in B for c in w): continue
            sc=sum(lpwm[B[c],j] for j,c in enumerate(w))
            if sc>best: best,pos=sc,(st,i,w)
    return best,pos

# null from iteration above, recomputed identically (seed 1, 8 blocks of 50 kb)
rng=np.random.default_rng(1); GL=6181863; blocks=[]
for _ in range(8):
    st=int(rng.integers(1,GL-50000)); blocks.append(seq(st,st+50000)); time.sleep(0.3)
big="".join(blocks)
null=np.array([best_score(big[i:i+400])[0] for i in range(0,len(big)-400,400)][:900])

TEST=["PP_0908","PP_0909","PP_0910","pvdS","fpvA","pfeA","fur","PP_0907"]
res=[]
for g in TEST:
    try:
        c=coords(g); time.sleep(0.4)
        if c is None: print("not found:",g); continue
        up=upstream(c); time.sleep(0.3)
        sc,pos=best_score(up)
        res.append(dict(gene=g,coords=str(c),score=round(float(sc),2),
                        pct_vs_null=round(float(100*(null<sc).mean()),1),
                        strand=pos[0],offset=pos[1],site=pos[2]))
    except Exception as ex: print("fail",g,repr(ex)[:70])
D=pd.DataFrame(res).sort_values("score",ascending=False)
D.to_csv("PP_0908_fur_box_scan.csv",index=False)
print("null: mean %.2f sd %.2f, 95th %.2f, 99th %.2f; perfect consensus = %.2f"%(
    null.mean(),null.std(),np.percentile(null,95),np.percentile(null,99),
    sum(lpwm[B[c],j] for j,c in enumerate(CONS))))
print(); print(D.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,4.2))
ax.hist(null,bins=40,color="#cccccc",edgecolor="white",label="400 bp genomic windows (n=%d)"%len(null))
ax.axvline(np.percentile(null,99),color="#444444",ls="--",lw=1,label="99th percentile of null")
cols={"PP_0908":"#b2182b","pvdS":"#2166ac","fpvA":"#2166ac","pfeA":"#2166ac"}
for r in D.itertuples():
    if r.gene in cols:
        ax.axvline(r.score,color=cols[r.gene],lw=2)
        ax.text(r.score,ax.get_ylim()[1]*(0.9 if r.gene=="PP_0908" else 0.72),
                " %s (%.1f)"%(r.gene,r.score),color=cols[r.gene],fontsize=9,rotation=90,va="top")
ax.set_xlabel("best Fur-box PWM score in the 400 bp upstream region (bits)")
ax.set_ylabel("number of windows")
ax.set_title("Fur-box search upstream of PP_0908 against a genomic null\nred = PP_0908, blue = known iron-starvation genes of P. putida KT2440",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
